name: Summit AZ - Blog Cluster - July Monsoon 2026
body:
> Blog · Summit Az · 2026-07-21

# Summary
Four supporting posts for the July monsoon calendar slot. The pillar "Monsoon Season and Your Plumbing: Preventing Backups and Flooding" was already live (2026-07-06, `/blog/monsoon-season-plumbing-backups/`), so writing a second pillar would cannibalize it; these four go deeper on sub-topics and link up.

# Posts (keyword, intent)
1. Why Do My Drains Gurgle and Drain Slowly When It Rains? (gurgling / slow drains when it rains, troubleshooting). Live 2026-07-31 at `/blog/gurgling-slow-drains-when-it-rains/`.
2. Clog or Sewer Line Problem? (clog vs sewer line problem, comparison). Live 2026-07-31.
3. Tree Roots in Your Sewer Line (Monsoon) (tree roots in sewer line, cause). Live 2026-07-14.
4. Sewage Backing Up in a Storm? What to Do Now (sewage backup what to do, emergency how-to). Live 2026-07-14.
Live dates are from the 2026-10-12 page tracker sync.

# Key facts
- Author on all Summit posts at the time: Ty Lemieux (`/blog/author/summitplumbingpros/`). The later water-pressure cluster switched to no byline.
- Monsoon runs June 15 to Sept 30, peaking mid-July to mid-August; the 30 to 45 day pre-peak rule means next year these should publish late May or early June.
- Holds: pricing and free-estimate language held for Scott; `[FIRST-HAND DETAIL]` placeholders need real Summit photos or job notes.
- City-page canonical ambiguity: both `/mesa-plumbing/` and `/general-plumbing-services-in-mesa/` patterns exist; drafts used the nav pattern and recommend 301-ing the loser.

# Open items in the file
1. Leave the existing pillar as-is or refresh it.
2. First-hand details or photos for four placeholders.
3. Scott sign-off on pricing or financing language.
4. Confirm the canonical city-page pattern.
